run_training_loop: run the training loop with a PyTorch Lightning trainer and GeneralizedRCNNTask to train a model
run_evaluation: run evaluation on a pre-trained model using a PyTorch Lightning trainer and task
save_checkpoint: save a model checkpoint to the output directory after training completes
dump_trained_model_configs: dump trained model configurations to the output directory with updated model weights path
review_training_loop: review the training loop functions that handle model training and evaluation with PyTorch Lightning
